---
title: "Halvorsen System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& ax-y-z-y^2\\
\dot{y} &=& ay-z-x-z^2\\
\dot{z} &=& az-x-y-x^2
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-0.32$ and initial condition $(-2,0,0)$.
